facts.fact: The ICT ministry's National Broadband Policy tabulates 15% of District Administrations as having basic internet access and 2% a fibre connection, and says connection remains low at district and local administration level; no numerator, denominator or date is given, so the published date is used.

The same table of the National Broadband Policy gives 1% of Sub county Administrations as having basic internet access and 0% a fibre connection; no numerator, denominator or date is given, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Internet access of Sub county Administrations

facts.fact: The policy lists, among management systems in use in government supported by broadband connectivity, the finance ministry's Integrated Financial Management System rolled out to 102 local government sites and its Program Budgeting System rolled out to 160 Local Government votes; no date is given, so the published date is used.
facts.system: IFMS and PBS at local government sites

facts.fact: The policy states that the Integrated Financial Management System, a centralised system supported by broadband connectivity, has been rolled out to 102 LG sites, beside 75 central government sites; it gives no total of local governments and no date, so the published date is used.

The policy states that the Program Budgeting System has been rolled out to 160 Local Government votes, beside 142 central government votes; it gives no total and no date, so the published date is used, and it does not say the votes enter it from their own offices.

systems.tiers: 102 LG sites, 75 central government sites, 12 referral hospitals, 12 public universities and tertiary institutions, 35 missions
